answers: The meeting was mainly about conceptual design. In the beginning, the group focused on industrial components: energy, material and interface. The industrial designer preferred traditional batteries, titanium and simple push buttons so that they would have enough money for speech recognition. After that, the group talked about LCD display and locating methods. The second topic was user interface concept, which was basically a good-looking design with few buttons. The group decided to change the colour of the assembly at an extra charge to meet special needs. To make a smart controller, they mentioned speech recognition and user identification. When it came to trend watching, the marketing put forward three noteworthy aspects - being fancy, technologically innovative and useful. The group agreed to follow the trend but the specific design was not decided.

full.prediction: The meeting focused on discussing the conceptual design of a new remote control. Key topics included choosing between battery or solar power, material options like titanium or rubber, interface design with push buttons or LCD displays, and incorporating speech recognition technology. The team also considered trends in design, emphasizing a "fancy" look and feel, and explored ideas such as spongy or fruit-shaped designs. They decided to explore two design options—titanium with a fruity scent and a spongy, fruit-shaped design—and agreed to create prototypes using modeling clay. The meeting concluded with plans for individual tasks and a follow-up meeting in thirty minutes.
